Приехал в отель в 3:00PM, на двери есть QR-код для регистрации, я зарегистрировался и перешел в приложение GOKI, но там сказано было что вы не зарегистрированы и соответственно нет никаких кодов для того, чтобы попасть в комнату и внутрь здания! В итоге я простоял на улице у двери в отель под дождем до практически 05:00PM, так как никто не отвечал на мои сообщения по почте, в букинге, в ватсап с 1:30PM! Ответили только ближе к 5 вечера, и пришлось ждать когда мне отправят коды от дверей! Причина в том, что якобы сотрудник не видел мои сообщения!!! В общем много времени потрачено впустую при онлайн заселении. По поводу хранения багажа, если вы привыкли оставлять в отеле, то это не ваш вариант, оставить можно только до полудня! И они могли бы пойти мне навстречу, с учетом того, что два часа я не мог попасть в свою комнату, но нет, мне отказали, можно только до полудня, а у меня вылет был вечером! Из-за проблем с регистрацией я не смог зарегистрироваться на ужин. По поводу чистоты, ну помойте вы уже окна в комнатах с «видом» на мост и оперу, там просто разглядеть надо все через эту грязь. В зоне кухни грязно, ремонт сделан приятный в светлых тонах, но везде грязь! Грязные раковины, зона готовки, в раковине еда, посуда не мытая! В общем сначала хотел забронировать еще на 6 ночей через неделю, но это того не стоит, поэтому передумал.

I found this response extreme and unjustified. When I tried to discuss the situation, the manager was combative, dismissive, and ultimately hung up on me, stating he didn’t care and that I was effectively evicted. I also later received a note about a bottle of rosé wine, even though I was not drinking and have never done so on the premises, which added to the confusion. Check-in is restricted due to “cleaning,” however, upon arrival, the room was clearly not properly cleaned. Floors were not vacuumed, trash was left behind, and during my three-night stay, the room was never cleaned. The document also states that bed sheets are changed daily unless requested otherwise and that rooms are cleaned every day. Neither of these services were provided. On my last day, after previous guests checked out, I pointed out leftover trash to the cleaning staff. When I returned later that evening, the trash was still there. The only action taken was placing a new garbage bag. There is only one bathroom per floor for approximately four or five rooms, resulting in constant queues. The bathroom was noisy, poorly maintained, and lacked basic amenities. Towels are not provided and cost $10 to rent, which is significantly higher than typical hostel rates. Breakfast and dinner are advertised as included, but both are offered only within a very limited one-hour window, which is impractical given the number of guests. Dinner was extremely basic, with no beverages included. When water was requested, only tap water was offered. Considering the overall hygiene standards of the property, this was concerning. There is no physical reception — communication is via a remote screen, and assistance was limited and inconsistent.

reviews.title: Nice hostel, but poor food, and no on-site staff.
reviews.positive: Positives : - 3 mins walk to Kings Cross station - cooking facilities available. - laundry was $4AUD for wash and the same for the drier.
reviews.negative: Negatives : - no staff on site - all comms are online, or via a video call on a monitor at the entrance - dinner is awful. Truly bad. We got mash and an under-cooked chicken one night. I had to buy a curry from a Thai restaurant opposite, cos I couldn't risk eating the chicken. - Breakfast is very basic. Cereals, toast and jam. It's meant to be served at 7:30am, but one day it didn't become available till 7:50 - an issue for me cos I had to rush to the airport to catch my flight. - The comms keep saying that dinner is from 6:30pm onwards, but it's NOT. It's not available until 7:30pm. This inconvenienced myself and two other guests, as we had all come back to the hostel for 6:30pm to be fed. A simple change in the Wattsapp message is not much effort for the hotel management to make. - there are cameras everywhere and signs everywhere saying "Smoking.....alcohol....$500 fine", "Not cleaning your dishes....$100 fine" etc etc. You feel like a person in a Big Brother House being watched at all times. Tip : stay in the Harbour View room - it's facing away from the street so you won't hear any noise.

reviews.positive: The location is excellent—just a few minutes’ walk from Kings Cross Station, and within walking distance to the Royal Botanic Gardens, the Art Gallery of NSW, the State Library, and even the Sydney Opera House, all under 30 minutes away. The included dinner is a nice bonus and much appreciated. However, during my 6-night stay, the menu was quite repetitive (two nights of pasta and four nights of biryani). A bit more variety would definitely improve the experience. The area feels safe, and the location alone makes this place a convenient base for exploring Sydney. With a few adjustments, especially around dining options and room amenities, this could be an even better stay.
reviews.negative: The hostel does not have a lift, and the hallways are very narrow, which makes moving around with luggage a bit difficult. The shower/toilet and common areas also feel quite cramped. At night, when the kitchen is closed, the only available common space is very small, so it may not be ideal for those who need to do remote work while traveling. Another small inconvenience is that there are no hooks in the rooms for towels or other items.

Isso porque eu especificamente havia requerido um quarto exclusivo para mulheres para minha mãe. Não conseguiram e nem resolveram esse problema. O banheiro estava frequentemente sujo e está precisando de reforma. Em uma das noites, um grupo de hóspedes começou a gritar e cantar no quarto ao lado, estilo karaoke. Durou uma hora. E não havia ninguém no hostel para fazer alguma coisa a respeito. Foi a minha pior experiência em hostels na minha vida. Piora: acompanhado pela minha mãe aventureira pela primeira vez. Não acreditem nas fotos bem produzidas. Elas também me enganaram. A vista que prometem da ponte, é por uma janela ao lado da pia do lavabo do quarto. Uma piada. Enfim... é sujo, lotado, barulhento e mal organizado.

Great experience at Azzurro
reviews.positive: I loved staying at Azzurro. The location is one of the best in the whole city, it has a beautiful view of the Opera House and it's close to a lot of useful establishments for students and backpackers, such as the Kings Cross library, the Kings Cross train station, supermarkets, grocery stores, washing house, pubs, restaurants and more. The hostel fulfills the proposal of being a non party hostel. Despite that, this is the perfect place to be surrounded by people from several countries and it's very easy to make friends, people are very kind and friendly. The beds are very comfortable, mostly because of the bedding set and the curtains they have in it. The staff is great, they are friendly and whatever you need they will help.
reviews.negative: The common areas are not very clean, especially the tables, and there's not much space to put your supermarket things in the storerooms or in the fridges, so try not to buy a lot of things!!! The hostel is not responsible for your belongings, so keep a careful eye to your belongings, mostly small things, for example, jewelery or your umbrella, because people will steal it. I'm not saying this is a characteristic of this hostel. It could happen anywhere, but be careful. The food could be better and have more meal variations, but, at least, they are very generous about it, so it's impossible to starve.

reviews.positive: The people I met were lovely and was sad to end my stay early for that.
reviews.negative: Honestly, I never thought I'd write a bad review but I'm quite disappointed at this point. I was given a room in the basement which was fine but it was quite stuffy and it smelt very damp. They gave me a new room but I had to pay an upgrade. The new room was a bit better but still smelt. There wasn't any staff, just a virtual receptionist which is fine but makes it a little harder to speak to someone. Most people there seem to be inbetween jobs/working which is also fine but not the vibe I was looking for (everyone I met was lovely though). By this point I was tempted to leave. The last thing that made me leave was when I pulled the curtain in my bed to get out, it fell and hit my face. It hurt! I spoke to them over WhatsApp and they were very apologetic. However, no one got back to me about a resolution and to be honest I never expect a refund or anything but was quite fed up by this point and just disappointed no one got back to me even after reminding them. I hate writing bad reviews and understand hostels are hostels but I do expect the basics to be decent at least. I waited a while before writing this but I needed to be honest.
